title: Goat Cheese Soufflé with Thyme
blurb: Light, airy soufflés with tangy goat cheese and fresh thyme, baked until golden and risen.
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C and butter two individual ramekins thoroughly, then dust with a little flour.
Melt the butter in a saucepan, stir in the flour and cook for one minute, then gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened.
Remove from the heat and stir in the goat cheese, thyme leaves, salt and pepper until the cheese melts, then beat in the egg yolks one at a time.
Whisk the egg whites in a clean bowl until they form stiff peaks.
Fold a spoonful of the whites into the cheese mixture to loosen it, then gently fold in the remaining whites until just combined.
Divide the mixture between the ramekins, filling them three-quarters full, and run your thumb around the inside rim to help them rise evenly.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until risen and golden on top, then serve immediately.
